We propose a new Bayesian Browsing Model to estimate the relevance of URLs for a given query.

(i) we propose a novel Bayesian Browsing Model to estimate URL relevance from click log data; (ii) we show that BBM can achieve better performance than the previous methods, including the state-of-the-art; (iii) we propose an efficient inference algorithm for BBM, which is single-pass and scalable; (iv) we show that our method can be applied to a real-world search engine, and can improve the quality of search results.

the following question: how can we use a large amount of data to improve the quality of search?
the problem of how to estimate the relevance of URLs for given queries.
